WHY TODAY
2025 return (Blick) should be filed by Oct 15. Blick is done with US work after this. You need a US-only CPA engaged before mid-November so they can (a) resize the Q4 estimate due Jan 15, 2027, (b) advise on a Roth conversion that must execute by Dec 31, 2026, and (c) be onboarded before their Jan–Apr busy season, when good CPAs stop taking clients. If 2025 isn't filed yet, start the search anyway.

STEP 1 — OPEN THE CLAUDE TAX PROJECT AND ASK:
"Build my 2026 CPA handoff brief and interview questions." It should produce a one-page brief covering:
• Filing status 2026 (single if divorce judgment entered by Dec 31, 2026 — otherwise MFS; confirm with Charli)
• No California filing for 2026 (residency terminated mid-2025 — CA exit position + 180 Palo Alto sale already on 2025)
• Income map: Fidelity 1099s (1615, 8737, 4342, 2503, cash mgmt accts), K-1s (DCVC, Capricorn, others), inherited IRA (BDA) RMD, Schedule C (advisory/founder/authorship; PocketSmith export by tax category)
• IRS interest income $2,128.86 from the 2023 amended refund — 1099-INT will mail to 1 Burgundy Way, Yountville under Nathan's SSN. Report on 2026 return regardless of whether the form is in hand.
• 2026 estimated payments made (Q1 Apr 1, Q2 Jun 16, Q3 Sep 15 via pay1040.com) and 90%-of-current-year method
• Foreign Tax Credit carryforward (UK PAYE-derived; separate property per divorce settlement)
• UK items: FIG regime year 2, no UK-source income, Smart Pension (FBAR/8938 reportable), US-UK treaty positions
• §183 hobby-loss defense file (Matt Creech memo May 2026 + Baker Tilly memo)
• Roth conversion status (pending Leah's UK treatment analysis)
• Delaware entity (Stealth Regtech) dissolution status
• Whether to file Form 8822 to move IRS address of record from Yountville to London

STEP 2 — WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN THE CPA
• US CPA (or EA) with real expat experience: Form 1116 FTC, US-UK treaty, FBAR/8938, foreign pensions. Not a generalist.
• Comfortable with: K-1-heavy portfolios, inherited IRA rules, QOZ (Form 8997), Schedule C with §183 exposure, Roth conversion modeling, California non-residency defense if FTB ever asks.
• Fixed fee, not retainer. Target: well under Blick's ~£10k+VAT. A federal-only return of this shape should be a few thousand dollars, not five figures.
• Willing to do one short call with Leah/Blick on FTC ↔ FIG interaction, then work async by email.
• Ask them: "How would you handle a $100–150k Roth conversion for a UK resident in the FIG window?" A good answer names the treaty and FIG; a bad one hedges.
• Don't sign a long engagement letter; do 2026 only and reassess.

STEP 3 — CONFIRM 2025 IS CLOSED
• 2025 return e-filed and accepted (Blick/Neeraj); balance due paid
• 2025 FBAR filed (BSA E-Filing; automatic extension ended Oct 15)
• Blick final invoice reconciled

OTHER TAX DATES ON THE HORIZON
• Sep 15, 2026 — Q3 federal estimate (resize if 2025 return is done)
• Oct 15, 2026 — 2025 return + FBAR deadline
• Dec 31, 2026 — divorce judgment must be entered for single status; Roth conversion deadline; inherited IRA RMD deadline; Delaware franchise tax keeps accruing if entity not dissolved
• Jan 15, 2027 — Q4 federal estimate
• Jan 31, 2027 — first UK Self Assessment (2025/26) due — Neeraj needs UTR; FIG claim
• Late Jan 2027 — IRS 1099-INT arrives in Yountville (ask sister to photo it)
• Feb–Mar 2027 — Fidelity 1099s; K-1s trickle Mar–Sep (expect extension again)
• Mar 1, 2027 — Delaware franchise tax due if Stealth Regtech still exists
• Apr 15, 2027 — 2026 return or extension; 2026 FBAR
• ~Apr 2029 — FIG window ends (4 UK tax years); IHT long-term-resident clock ~2034/35
